definitions.explanation: An unpleasant or difficult experience that often provides a valuable lesson.

examples.japanese: {苦|にが}い{経験|けいけん}をした。
{過去|かこ}の{苦|にが}い{経験|けいけん}から{学|まな}んだ。
examples.english: I learned from past bitter experiences.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}い{頃|ころ}の{苦|にが}い{経験|けいけん}が、{今|いま}の{自分|じぶん}を{作|つく}っている。
examples.english: The bitter experiences of my youth have shaped who I am today.

notes:
{苦|にが}い{経験|けいけん} refers to difficult experiences that often teach valuable lessons.

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
- {苦|にが}い{思|おも}い{出|で}: bitter memory
- {辛|つら}い{経験|けいけん}: painful experience
- {酷|ひど}い{目|め}: terrible experience

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {苦|にが}い{経験|けいけん}をする: to have a bitter experience
- {苦|にが}い{経験|けいけん}から{学|まな}ぶ: to learn from bitter experience
- {苦|にが}い{経験|けいけん}を{生|い}かす: to make use of bitter experience
